title: Configure Vercel AI SDK client with Anthropic provider
description: Set up the Vercel AI SDK client in src/lib/ai/client.ts with the Anthropic provider. This is the single place where the AI model is configured and where the Anthropic API key is accessed.
acceptanceCriteria: `src/lib/ai/client.ts` exports an `anthropic` provider instance and a `model` constant
ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is read from environment variables
A simple `generateText` call with the model works end-to-end

steps.details: Create a quick test: import `model` and call `generateText({ model, prompt: 'Say hello' })`. Confirm it returns a text response. Delete the test file after verification.

technicalNotes: All AI pipeline functions (generate-structure.ts, generate-content.ts, condense.ts) import `model` from this file.
If switching to a different Anthropic model in future, only this file changes.
The Vercel AI SDK handles retries automatically for transient failures.
